questions.text: The API has no conversation or action-plan code yet, so nothing can report 'query ended with a completed action plan'. How should this work item record free-query use?
options: Add a recording function (one use per query id, safe to call twice) that the future conversation feature calls; tests call it directly
Also add an internal endpoint to record a use
Wait until the conversation feature exists and build both together
questions.reason: Requirement criteria 5 and 6 depend on an event the codebase does not produce yet; this decides what WI-015 builds and how it is tested.
questions.answer: Add a recording function (one use per query id, safe to call twice) that the future conversation feature calls; tests call it directly

questions.text: The API scopes all data to a tenant. Is a user's free-query count per tenant or one count across all their tenants?
options: Per tenant (each tenant gives its own 2 free queries)
One count per user across all tenants
questions.reason: All existing data access is tenant-scoped (reports, multi-tenant module); the requirement does not mention tenants, and the answer changes the table design and the balance a user sees.
questions.answer: Per tenant (each tenant gives its own 2 free queries)

questions.text: Where should the configurable allowance (default 2) be set?
options: One global value in the existing settings table
Per tenant, falling back to a global default of 2
questions.reason: REQ-264 says the allowance is configurable but not at what level; the settings table is global while user data is per tenant.
questions.answer: One global value in the existing settings table
